entities.summary: Ashoka, a notable figure in the history of Pakistan, associated with Achaemenid, Greek, and Mauryan Period (305 BCE–185 BCE). Preceded by Maurya Empire and Darius I. Their legacy influenced Ashoka's Rock Edicts carved at Mansehra and Shahbazgarhi in Pakistan.
